subject: Silverline – stakeholder roles, buying steps & MAP draft
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@silverlinehealth.com>
Cc: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@silverlinehealth.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 15:24:00 -0800
Subject: Silverline – stakeholder roles, buying steps & MAP draft

Hi Aisha —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap + next steps so we’re all aligned and I don’t miss anyone in the process:

Key decision criteria you called out:
- Performance and predictable latency for peak-hours triage workflows
- Data residency and auditability (logs retained for 7 years)
- Cost-per-transaction targets to keep pilot economics favorable

Stakeholder map (from our chat):
- Economic buyer: Tom Reyes (VP of Ops) — approves contract and budget
- Security/Privacy reviewer: Aisha Khan (Head of IT Security) — questionnaire + SOC2 evidence
- Procurement: procurement@silverlinehealth.com — PO and standard T&C redlines
- Pilot owner / evaluator: Dr. Elena Morales (clinical lead) — success metrics for pilot

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) — timeline and ownership:
1) Security questionnaire submitted (you) — target: 2026-02-12
2) Pilot data access & sample dataset provided (Silverline) — target: 2026-02-16
3) Redwood sends pilot config + runbook (Marcus) — target: 2026-02-18
4) Two-week pilot (Silverline) — 2026-02-19 to 2026-03-05
5) Procurement issues PO / final contract (Tom/Procurement) — target: 2026-03-10

I attached a lightweight MAP spreadsheet that maps owners to deliverables — please review and edit as needed. Two asks for you now:
1) Confirm Tom is the final economic approver and procurement contact above is correct.
2) If possible, share the completed security questionnaire (PDF) or tell us which specific evidence docs you need.

If this looks good I’ll convert the spreadsheet to a shared Drive doc and add granular dates/owners. Happy to jump on a 15-min follow-up tomorrow if helpful.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Senior AE, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Silverline_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 sheet)
From: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@silverlinehealth.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@silverlinehealth.com>, procurement@silverlinehealth.com
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 09:11:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Silverline – stakeholder roles, buying steps & MAP draft

Dylan —

Thanks for the clear recap. Quick notes:
- Confirmed: Tom is the final economic approver. I’ll loop in Dr. Morales separately for pilot metrics.
- Procurement contact is procurement@silverlinehealth.com (CC’d). They’ll need our SOW + pricing sheet to start the PO thread.
- I’ve attached the partially completed security questionnaire — you’ll see a couple of items we’ll want sample logs for (retention & access controls).

We can aim to get the remaining questionnaire items back to you by 2026-02-12 EOD. If Redwood can provide a short note on log retention (where stored, how long, encryption at rest) that would speed things up.

For the MAP spreadsheet I noted two edits (ownership swaps) — I’ll add comments directly in the file in Drive.

Aisha Khan
Head of IT Security
Silverline Health

Attachments: SL_security_questionnaire_filled.pdf (form, 12 pages)

Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 12:02:00 -0800

On Wed, Feb 11, 2026 at 09:11 AM Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@silverlinehealth.com> wrote:
> Dylan —
>
> Thanks for the clear recap. Quick notes: ...

Thanks team — I’ll prepare the pilot config and the runbook once we get the sample dataset. Action items I’ll own:
- Pilot infra template (GPU profile, batching config) — deliver by 2026-02-18
- Short note for Aisha on logging & retention: we keep audit logs in encrypted S3 with 7-year retention; access via role-based IAM; HSM for key management. I’ll paste the official blurb in the Drive doc.
- Pricing sheet + SOW draft (to start procurement) — first pass by 2026-02-16

Grace, can you help validate the billing cadence assumptions for the pilot? I noted Silverline prefers monthly invoices instead of upfront credits.

— Marcus
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Silverline – stakeholder roles, buying steps & MAP draft

Aisha / Tom / procurement team —

Following up to confirm a few things before we lock dates:
1) Aisha: thanks for the questionnaire — Marcus’s blurb is in Drive (link below). Confirmed target to return outstanding items by EOD 2026-02-12 — I see you completed much of it.
2) Tom / procurement: to start the PO thread we can send a short SOW + pricing sheet (Marcus will attach). Are monthly invoices acceptable for pilot billing? If so we’ll set pilot billing cadence monthly and invoice per usage.
3) MAP: I uploaded an updated MAP in Drive with the changes Aisha suggested and added concrete owners/dates for the pilot kickoff on 2026-02-19. Link below.

Next steps (agreed):
- Silverline to provide sample dataset + access by 2026-02-16 (Aisha / Dr. Morales)
- Redwood to deliver pilot infra + SOW by 2026-02-18 (Marcus)
- Procurement to issue PO / sign by 2026-03-10 (procurement@silverlinehealth.com)

If those milestones still look good I’ll convert the spreadsheet to a live Drive doc and share an editor link.

Drive MAP: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b3c4d5e6f/view
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/78910

Thanks — let me know if we should slot a 15-min sync tomorrow.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
